premises.text: Art creation has become increasingly costly and time-consuming due to manual processes
premises.evidence_span: the $80 billion video game industry spends on average 61% of their project budgets on digital media creation

premises.text: Automation can halve the time and cost of art creation
premises.evidence_span: Our goal is to half the time and half the cost of this process through automation

premises.text: An AI system can mimic human-like artistic creativity
premises.evidence_span: We have built an artificial intelligence system that can mimic human-like artistic creativity

premises.text: Art-o-matics allows artists to create diverse outputs from example inputs
premises.evidence_span: Art-o-matics is an example base way of making art. That means you give the computer an example of something you want, and it makes more

premises.text: Art-o-matics can automate tedious tasks in the art creation process
premises.evidence_span: We automate the kind of work they don't want to do

premises.text: The company has identified video games as a primary market for its technology
premises.evidence_span: we've identified that video games are our beachhead

premises.text: The company aims to expand its technology to other industries beyond gaming
premises.evidence_span: we'd like to solve the same problems in other industries, as well as the problems of tomorrow

premises.text: The company controls all intellectual property and protects it through patents and trade secrets
premises.evidence_span: we control all of the IP, and we're protecting it through a combination of patents and trade secrets

value.text: Art creation becomes more efficient and accessible through automation
value.evidence_span: they're going to change the way you see the world

notes: Traction details and team backgrounds are excluded as they do not constitute premises.
